name: Gaylord
source:
A real jerk.

His mind was destroyed inside the boarding house he studied in, he was one of the weak kids.

While Natassja was pregnant he lived with them to convince Valerie's father of the genuinity of their marriage.

He had the gift of making people do what he wanted. The only one that never got under his spell was Valerie.

[In game description]
